Second safety read (Opus, read-only): clean

Scope: head `5c235886f516f9488892c45edcf6c804a8a38f14`. The PR is open and not merged. The base is `main`. The PR has one commit. Its parent `d911f4553` is on `origin/main`, so the PR carries no commits of other PRs. I did not build.

Findings:

1. The refusal decision does not change. The diff changes only the string literal in the non-iso arm of `refusal()` in `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/axis.rs`. The call site (`fit(...).map_or_else(|| refusal(iso), Ok)`, line 167), the axis fit and the `iso` test do not change. Each input that refused before still refuses. No input that refused before now passes. The iso (sphere) message does not change.
2. Callers stay correct. All existing asserts match `share no rotation axis` or `equally`. The two texts stay in the messages (motion lib tests, `crates/motion/tests/rotary*.rs`, `crates/app/tests/operations.rs`, `crates/app/tests/lathe_spindle_keyed.rs`). No code matched the removed words `a turned workpiece is rotary work`.
3. Pins. The new test `the_freeform_refusal_names_the_4_axis_case` asserts `not a shape of revolution`, `4-axis`, `#2772` and `5-Axis kinds`. It fails on the old text, because the old text has no `4-axis` and no `#2772`. Existing tests pin the unchanged iso branch (`equally`, for example `axis_poles_tests.rs:74`, `tests/rotary.rs:168`).
4. The message is accurate. It names the cause (no shape of revolution), the 4-axis limit, the tracking issue and the 5-axis remedy. Note, not a blocker: "clamped on A" assumes an A table. A machine with a B rotary is also possible. The text cites `#2772`. When #2772 closes, the text becomes old and a follow-up must update it.
5. The diff adds no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests. The `.unwrap()` calls near lines 409 and 419 were there before, and they are in the `#[cfg(test)]` module.
6. The commit and the body use `Refs #2772`, not a closing keyword. #2772 is open, which is correct. The PR changes no posted G-code or CL output.

Verdict: no blockers.

Coordinator: this PR merges by the maintainer's standing order of 2026-11-21 ("merge using the recommended option"). The reviews that this merge relies on, both on head 5c235886f: mkinney's collaborator marker (clean) and the second Opus safety read (comment 7076387022, clean). The refusal decision is unchanged; only the message text changes, and a new pin checks it. `main` is green. I merge it on head 5c235886f. It is a fork PR, so its branch stays. #2772 stays open (`Refs`).
